blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: With the rapid development of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), evaluating their video understanding capabilities has become increasingly important. Existing video understanding benchmarks cover only part of the evaluation dimensions, limiting systematic diagnosis of omni-modal video understanding. We introduce OmniCompass, a holistic benchmark for omni-modal video grounding and understanding. OmniCompass defines two evaluation tracks: OmniCompass-VL assesses vision-language models on tasks requiring visual evidence, while OmniCompass-AV assesses omni-modal models on tasks requiring joint audio-visual evidence. Each track includes three complementary tasks: temporal grounding (TG), spatial grounding (SG), and question answering (QA), assessing when a referenced target appears, where it is, and what happens. QA covers five perception and three reasoning categories in OmniCompass-VL, and three perception and two reasoning categories in OmniCompass-AV. OmniCompass-VL contains 820 videos and 2,460 instances across domains and three duration types: short, medium, and long. A narrative- and audio-rich subset forms OmniCompass-AV with 240 videos and 720 instances. Each instance is evaluated under two paired settings: text-only and text+image, specifying the same target through text and visual-language guidance. All instances are manually annotated with multi-round quality verification. Evaluations of 50 MLLMs show that open-source models still lag behind proprietary counterparts, particularly in audio-visual understanding. Precise temporal and spatial grounding remains challenging even for leading models, and their predictions still exhibit inconsistencies across the paired target specifications.
blocks.zh: 随着多模式大语言模型(MLLMs)的迅速发展,评价其视频理解能力变得日益重要. 现有的视频理解基准只涵盖部分评价层面,限制了对全方位模式视频理解的系统诊断. 我们引入了OmniCompass,这是全方位模式视频定位和理解的整体基准. OmniCompass 定义了两个评价轨道: OmniCompass-VL对需要视觉证据的任务进行视觉语言模型评估,而OmniCompass-AV对需要视听联合证据的任务进行全方位模型评估. 每个轨道包括三项相辅相成的任务:时间定位(TG)、空间定位(SG)和问答(QA),评估一个被引用的目标何时出现、在哪里以及会发生什么。 QA涵盖OmniCompass-VL中的5个认知和3个推理类,而OmniCompass-AV中的3个认知和2个推理类. OmniCompass-VL包含820个视频和2,460个跨域实例,以及短、中和长三种持续时间类型。 一个叙述和音频丰富的子集组成了OmniCompass-AV,包含240个视频和720个实例. 每个实例在两个对齐的设置下进行评估:仅文本和文本+图像,通过文本和可视语言指导来指定同一目标. 所有实例都用人工说明,并进行多轮质量核查。 对50个小额供资和微型企业的评价表明,开放源码模式仍然落后于专有模式,特别是在视听理解方面。 精确的时间和空间定位即使在领先的模型中也仍然具有挑战性,其预测仍然显示出成对的目标规格不一致。

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Human perception uses linguistic or visual cues to identify targets, attend to visual and auditory evidence across space and time, and form goal-directed judgments.
Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) jointly process images, videos, audio, and text, supporting multimodal understanding and reasoning ( Bai et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025b ; Google, 2025 ) .
Recent MLLMs can revisit relevant temporal clips ( Yang et al., 2026a ; Zeng et al., 2026b ) , inspect task-relevant spatial evidence ( Wang et al., 2026c ; Meng et al., 2026 ) , and selectively acquire audio-visual evidence during reasoning ( Xing et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) .
These advances motivate evaluating omni-modal video grounding and understanding.
This requires identifying targets from textual or visual cues, grounding them spatiotemporally, and integrating audio-visual evidence to understand events.
blocks.zh:
人类的认知使用语言或视觉提示来识别目标,关注跨时空的视觉和听觉证据,并形成以目标为导向的判断.
多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)联合处理图像、视频、音频和文本,支持多式联运的理解和推理(Bai等,2025;徐等,2025b;Google,2025)。
近期的MLLMs可以重温相关的时间片段(Yang等人,2026a; Zeng等,2026b.),检查与任务相关的空间证据(Wang等,2026c;Meng等,2026.),在推理过程中有选择地获取视听证据(Xing等,2026;Chen等,2026.
这些进展促使人们评价全方位模式的视频定位和理解。
这需要从文字或视觉提示中确定目标,迅速将其定位,并整合视听证据以了解事件。

blocks.en:
With the rapid development of MLLMs, how to comprehensively evaluate their performance in complex video understanding tasks has become an important problem.
Table 1 compares existing benchmarks across four dimensions. (i) Target Specification defines how targets are presented: through only textual queries ( Fu et al., 2025a ) or with reference images ( Ma et al., 2026 ) . (ii) Video Evidence distinguishes tasks resolved from video frames ( Chen et al., 2025a ) from those requiring synchronized audio-visual content ( Hong et al., 2026 ) . (iii) Task Coverage specifies the output: temporal grounding (TG) and spatial grounding (SG) predict target-specific intervals and regions ( Lei et al., 2021 ; Cheng et al., 2026 ) , while question answering (QA) predicts answers ( Fu et al., 2026 ) . (iv) Video Duration determines the temporal scope: short-video benchmarks emphasize fine-grained motion and local dynamics ( Li et al., 2024b ) , whereas long-video benchmarks test long-range dependencies and information integration across temporally distant events ( Zhou et al., 2025a ) .
blocks.zh:
随着MLLMs的迅速发展,如何在复杂的视频理解任务中全面评价其性能已经成为一个重要问题.
表1比较了四个方面的现有基准。 (一)目标规格确定如何表述目标:仅通过文字查询(Fu等,2025a)或参考图像(Ma等,2026). (二)视频. 证据将解决的任务与视频框架(Chen等人,2025a)和需要同步视听内容的任务(Hong等人,2026年)区分开来。 (三) 任务覆盖范围具体规定了产出:时间定位(TG)和空间定位(SG)预测具体目标的间隔和区域(Lei等人,2021年;Cheng等人,2026年),而问题答案(QA)预测答案(Fu等人,2026年)(四) 视频持续时间决定了时间范围:短视频基准强调精细运动和地方动态(Li等人,2024年b),而长视频基准测试长期依赖和跨时间遥远事件的信息整合(Zhou等人,2025年a年)。

blocks.en:
Despite this progress, existing benchmarks have three limitations in systematically diagnosing omni-modal video grounding and understanding. (i) Limited video-evidence coverage. Benchmarks typically assess either visual information ( Chen et al., 2025a ) or synchronized audio-visual content ( Hong et al., 2026 ) .
In news broadcasts, some queries concern visible scenes; others require aligning spoken reports with people or events.
Both settings are needed to assess visual perception and audio-visual integration. (ii) Inflexible target-specification settings. Most benchmarks use only text ( Fu et al., 2026 ) , while IV-Bench combines reference images with text ( Ma et al., 2026 ) .
Practical targets may be specified verbally or with an image, yet these benchmarks do not evaluate the same target under both settings. (iii) Fragmented task coverage. Most benchmarks focus on QA ( Li et al., 2024b ) or grounding ( Gao et al., 2026 ) ; audio-visual benchmarks rarely cover the latter ( Li et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2025b ) .
In basketball games, users may ask when a referenced player scores, where the player is on the court, and what happens.
Joint evaluation distinguishes failures in temporal retrieval, spatial localization, and semantic understanding.
blocks.zh:
尽管取得了这些进展,但现有基准在系统地诊断全方位模式视频定位和理解方面存在三个局限性。 (一) 视频证据报道有限。 基准通常评估视觉信息(Chen等人,2025年a)或同步视听内容(Hong等人,2026年)。
在新闻广播中,有些查询涉及可看见的场景;另一些则需要将口头报道与人或事件相配合.
需要两种环境来评估视觉感知和视听融合。 (二) 不灵活的针对性目标设置。 大多数基准只使用文本(Fu等,2026年),而IV-Bench将参考图像和文本(Ma等,2026年)合并.
实际目标可以口头或带有图像,但这些基准在两种情况下都不评估相同目标。 (三) 任务覆盖面分散。 大多数基准侧重于质量评估(Li等,2024年b)或地面评估(Gao等,2026年b);视听基准很少涵盖后者(Li等,2026年;周等,2025年b).
在篮球比赛中,用户可能询问被引用的玩家得分时间,球员在球场上的位置,以及会发生什么.
联合评价区分了时间检索、空间定位和语义理解方面的失败。

blocks.en:
To address these gaps, we introduce OmniCompass , a holistic benchmark for omni-modal video grounding and understanding.
As shown in Figure 2 , OmniCompass has four key features: (i) Complementary Video Evidence. OmniCompass-VL evaluates understanding from visual content, while OmniCompass-AV additionally requires audio. (ii) Flexible Target Specification. Each instance pairs Text and Text+Image settings, specifying the same target through language alone or with a reference image.
The video, task semantics, and ground truth are the same.
We introduce Cross-Specification Consistency Scores (CS) to jointly measure task accuracy and prediction consistency across these settings. (iii) Unified Task Coverage. Both tracks provide TG, SG, and QA tasks per video.
The VL track covers five perception and three reasoning categories,
whereas the AV track covers three perception and two reasoning categories. (iv) Diverse Durations and Content. OmniCompass-VL contains 820 videos and 2,460 instances across short, medium, and long durations.
It combines public sports, traffic, surveillance, and documentary videos with 240 self-collected movie, TV, variety, and news videos.
This subset forms OmniCompass-AV with 720 instances.
blocks.zh:
为了弥补这些差距,我们引入了OmniCompass,这是全模式视频定位和理解的整体基准。
如图2所示,OmniCompass有四个关键特征:(一) 补充视频证据。 OmniCompass-VL从视觉内容评价理解,而OmniCompass-AV则额外需要音频. (二) 灵活的目标规格。 每个实例对齐了"文本"和"文本+图像"设置,通过语言单独或以参考图像指定了同一个目标.
视频,任务语义,和地上真理都是相同的.
我们采用跨规格一致性分数(CS)来共同测量这些设置中的任务准确性和预测一致性. (三) 统一任务覆盖。 两道音轨每道视频提供TG,SG,和QA任务.
VL轨迹包括了五个感知和三个推理类别,
而AV轨迹包括了三种感知和两种推理类别. (四) 不同期限和内容。 OmniCompass-VL包含820个视频和2 460个短、中和长段视频。
它将公共体育,交通,监控,纪录片视频与240部自收自支的电影,电视,品种,新闻视频相融合.
此子集构成 OmniCompass- AV 有720个实例 。

blocks.en:
We evaluate 50 MLLMs , including proprietary and open-source models.
The best proprietary model exceeds the best open-source model by 3.2% in CS Avg \mathrm{CS}^{\mathrm{Avg}} on VL track and 32.8% on AV track.
Strong QA performance coexists with weak grounding and cross-reference
inconsistency, even when aggregate accuracies are similar across settings.
Visual target specifications do not consistently help: Text+Image improves the single-setting average for only 11 of 36 models.
Further analyses show that timestamps substantially improve model performance across tasks and tracks, while audio consistently improves QA and TG performance on AV track.
Future MLLMs therefore need stronger cross-modal alignment and more reliable audio-aware grounding.
Our contributions are as follows:

因此,未来的MLLMs需要更强有力的跨模式协调以及更可靠的音频意识地面。
我们的捐款如下:

blocks.en:
1. A Holistic Evaluation Framework. OmniCompass unifies target-guided omni-modal video grounding and understanding across four dimensions: paired Text and Text+Image specifications, VL/AV evidence tracks, TG/SG/QA tasks, and short-to-long videos.
We introduce CS to jointly assess task correctness and consistency across paired target specifications. 2. A Diverse, Rigorously Verified Benchmark. OmniCompass spans 820 videos, 80.6 hours, seven domains, and 52 subcategories, with 240 videos shared between VL and AV tracks.
Construction required about 1,800 human-hours for annotator training, calibration, annotation, expert adjudication, and revision.
All instances undergo multi-round quality verification. 3. A Diagnostic Evaluation of MLLMs. We evaluate 50 different MLLMs, revealing an overall advantage for proprietary models, especially in audio-visual understanding.

Further analyses examine the effects of target specifications, video duration, timestamps, and input modalities.

blocks.en: 2  Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Multimodal Large Language Models for Video Understanding
blocks.zh: 2.1 视频理解多式大语文模型

blocks.en:
MLLMs connect language models with multimodal encoders for perception and reasoning ( Liu et al., 2024a ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2025a ; Google, 2025 ; Lin et al., 2025a ; Lin et al., 2025b ; An et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) .
LLaVA-OneVision ( Li et al., 2024a ) and LLaVA-Video ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) unify image-video modeling.
The latter uses synthetic captions and question-answering data for video instruction tuning.
LLaVA-OneVision-2 ( An et al., 2026 ) further adopts OneVision-Encoder ( Tang et al., 2026 ) for native-resolution visual encoding and efficient long-video processing through codec-aware token compression.
VideoLLaMA3 ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) and InternVL3.5 ( Wang et al., 2025b ) strengthen video training and reasoning.
Qwen3-VL ( Bai et al., 2025 ) improves long-context video understanding through temporal alignment, while Qwen3-Omni ( Xu et al., 2025b ) jointly processes vision, audio, and language.
Keye-VL-2.0 ( Team et al., 2026 ) adapts DSA for efficient long-context processing and consolidates task-specific capabilities through cross-modal MOPD.
TimeLens ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) improves temporal grounding with interleaved timestamps and thinking-free reinforcement learning, and TimeLens2 ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) further broadens task coverage through verified multi-interval supervision and temporal Wasserstein rewards.
Agentic extensions also explore tool-assisted video reasoning to selectively acquire task-relevant visual and audio evidence ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2026b ; Meng et al., 2026 ; Xing et al., 2026 ) .
In brief, modern omni-modal video understanding identifies referenced targets and grounds evidence in time and space by integrating visual and audio information.

后者使用合成字幕和问答数据来进行视频指令调音.
LLaVA-One Vision-2(An等,2026年)还进一步采用One Vision-Encoder(Tang等,2026年),用于本土分辨率的视觉编码和高效的长视频处理,通过codec-aware令牌压缩.
VideoLLAMA3(张等,2025年)和InternVL3.5(王等,2025b)加强视频培训与推理.
Qune3-VL(Bai等,2025年)通过时间对接来改善长文本视频理解,而Qune3-Omni(徐等,2025b)则联合处理视觉,音频,语言.
Keye-VL-2.0(Team等,2026年)为高效长文本处理而调整了DSA,并通过跨模式的MOPD来整合任务特有能力.

简言之,现代全方位模式的视频理解通过整合视觉和音频信息,在时间和空间中识别出被引用的目标和依据证据.

blocks.en: 2.2 Video Understanding Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 2.2 视频理解基准

blocks.en:
Table 1 compares existing benchmarks across four design dimensions. (i) Target Specification defines how the target is presented. Most benchmarks use textual questions or instructions ( Fu et al., 2025a ; Cheng et al., 2026 ) , while IV-Bench ( Ma et al., 2026 ) pairs text with a reference image for visual specification. (ii) Video Evidence distinguishes visual and audio-visual requirements. Vision-language benchmarks assess appearance, motion, and temporal relations. TempCompass ( Liu et al., 2024b ) evaluates temporal perception, while MotionBench ( Hong et al., 2025 ) targets fine-grained motion. WorldSense ( Hong et al., 2026 ) and JointAVBench ( Chao et al., 2026 ) require synchronized visual and native-audio evidence. (iii) Task Coverage defines the expected output. Question-answering benchmarks ( Fu et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2026 ) produce semantic responses, while grounding benchmarks require explicit evidence localization. OmniGround evaluates temporal intervals and spatial regions ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , and V-STaR ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) jointly assesses TG, SG, and QA. (iv) Video Duration sets the temporal scope for evidence integration. MVBench emphasizes local actions and temporal dynamics ( Li et al., 2024b ) , whereas LongVideoBench ( Wu et al., 2024 ) , MLVU ( Zhou et al., 2025a ) , and LVBench ( Wang et al., 2025a ) stress long-context management across distant moments.
LongVideoBench also evaluates referring reasoning over interleaved video frames and subtitles.
Existing benchmarks cover selected dimensions or fixed combinations, limiting diagnosis of target identification, grounding, and omni-modal reasoning across different target and evidence settings.

现有基准涵盖选定的维度或固定组合,限制了对不同目标和证据设置中的目标识别、定位和全方位模式推理的诊断。

blocks.en: OmniCompass unifies these dimensions through paired target-specification settings, complementary evidence tracks, and TG, SG, and QA across video durations. It supports diagnosis of target identification, spatio-temporal grounding, and event understanding under paired reference settings.

blocks.en: 3.2 Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 3.2 基准建设

blocks.en: Constructing OmniCompass requires approximately 1,800 human-hours for paired annotation, targeted revision, and multi-round quality verification, following the pipeline in Figure 3 .
blocks.zh: 建构OmniCompass需要大约1,800个人工小时,在图3的管道之后进行配对注释、定向修订和多轮质量核查。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Data construction pipeline. OmniCompass requires about 1,800 human-hours for rigorous annotation, verification, and revision. Stage 1: We screen 8,489 videos from nine public datasets, retain 6,946 after duration and referential-cue filtering, and select 580 to complement 240 self-collected videos. Stage 2: Four trained annotators independently construct paired Text and Text+Image TG, SG, and QA instances. AV cases include native audio. Stage 3: Annotators cross-verify and revise cases before final acceptance and correction by the lead expert, yielding 820 videos across seven domains, paired settings, two tracks, three tasks, and three duration groups.

blocks.en: Stage 1: Video Collection and Curation. We construct a pool of 8,489 candidate videos from nine public datasets and supplement it with 240 self-collected videos from films, TV series, variety shows, and news programs. The resulting pool covers seven high-level domains. Appendix Table C1 details the selection scope, characteristics, usage terms, and contributions of the public datasets to the final benchmark.
blocks.zh: 第1阶段:录像收集与校正。 我们从9个公共数据集构建了8 489个候选视频库,并补充了240个自取自自电影、电视连续剧、品种节目和新闻节目的视频。 由此产生的人才库涵盖七个高级别领域。 附录表C1详细列出了公共数据集对最终基准的选取范围,特征,用法术语和贡献.

blocks.en: We use Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct to profile each public candidate with structured entity , action , attribute , and scene cues. Excluding videos shorter than 30 seconds or missing any of the four referential cue types leaves 6,946 eligible videos . We rank them by four predefined criteria: reference necessity, grounding suitability, temporal-spatial utility, and evidence diversity (Appendix Table C2 ). Shortlisting follows domain, duration, source, and subcategory constraints. Manual review retains 580 high-quality videos ; with 240 self-collected videos, OmniCompass-VL contains 820 videos. The same 240 videos form OmniCompass-AV, with additional audio-visual task annotations. Appendix C details profiling, filtering, and scoring.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Qune3-VL-8B-指示来描述每个公共候选人, 不包括短于30秒的影片, 我们按四个预先确定的标准排列:参考必要性、确定适用性、空间时间效用和证据多样性(附录表C2)。 短名单遵循域、期限、来源和子类别限制。 手动审查保留了580个高质量视频;有240个自行收集的视频,OmniCompass-VL包含820个视频. 同为240个视频组成了OmniCompass-AV,并附加了视听任务说明. 附 录 C详细剖析,过滤,评分.

blocks.en: Stage 2: Task Annotation and Construction. A lead expert provides two days of task-specific training to four professional annotators before full-scale annotation. The team follows four principles to ensure consistent target specification and evidence across TG, SG, and QA under paired Text and Text+Image settings.
blocks.zh: 阶段2:任务说明和建设. 一名牵头专家向四名专业注释员提供两天的具体任务培训,然后再进行全面的说明。 团队遵循四项原则,以确保在对齐的"文本"和"文本+图像"设置下贯穿TG,SG,和QA的一致目标规格和证据.

blocks.en: (i) Same-Target Pairing. Each Text and Text+Image pair shares the same video, target, task semantics, and ground truth. In Text+Image , the textual expression requires the reference image to identify the target. (ii) Diverse Reference Types and Sources. References cover entity , action , attribute , and scene cues using video crops or semantically matched external images. Each image identifies the target without revealing the annotated event or answer evidence. For video-internal references, annotators favor a separate view outside the target interval or QA clue interval whenever available. (iii) Precise TG/SG Labels. TG intervals tightly cover complete target-related events, while SG boxes localize the same target at both interval boundaries. (iv) Evidence-Grounded QA Design. Following CG-Bench ( Chen et al., 2025a ) , annotators pair a clue interval with five mutually exclusive options: one correct answer and four plausible distractors.
blocks.zh: (一) 同目标对等。 每个文本和文本+图像配对共享相同的视频,目标,任务语义,以及地面真理. 在"Text+Image"中,文本表达需要参考图像来识别目标. (二) 不同参考类型和来源。 引用覆盖实体,动作,属性,以及使用视频收音机或精准匹配的外景图像的场景提示. 每个图像都识别目标,而不披露附加说明的事件或回答证据. 对于视频内部引用,注释者倾向于在目标间隔或QA线索间隔之外,在有可用时单独查看. (三) 精确的TG/SG标签。 TG间隔紧密地覆盖了完整的与目标相关的事件,而SG框则在两个间隔边界上将同一个目标本地化. (四) 证据组合质量保证设计。 继CG-Bench(Chen等,2025a.)后,注释者将一条线索间隔配上五个相互排斥的选项:一个正确的答案和四个可信的分心器.

blocks.en: The annotators first conduct a pilot annotation on 30 VL and 30 AV videos spanning all seven domains and three duration types. Each video receives one TG, one SG, and one QA instance under paired Text and Text+Image settings, yielding 180 task instances . The pilot exposes inconsistencies in target pairing, temporal boundaries, spatial target consistency, and QA evidence. The lead expert reviews these cases with the team, resolves ambiguities, and refines the guidelines. The annotators then independently construct the remaining instances under the calibrated protocol. Guideline training, pilot calibration, and initial task construction across both tracks and all three tasks account for approximately 960 annotator-hours .
blocks.zh: 注释者首先对30个VL和30个AV视频进行试点说明,涵盖所有七个领域和三个持续时间类型。 每个视频在对齐的文本和文本+图像设置下获得一个TG,一个SG和一个QA实例,产生180个任务实例. 飞行员暴露出目标配对,时间界限,空间目标一致性,以及质检证据等不一致之处. 牵头专家与小组审查这些案件,解决不明确之处并完善准则。 注释者然后根据校正协议独立构建其余实例。 指导性培训、试点校正和初步任务建造,跨越两条轨道和所有三项任务,大约占960个注释小时。

blocks.en: Stage 3: Quality Verification and Finalization. All annotated cases undergo case-level quality verification before release. Four annotators independently cross-check annotations from their peers against the Stage 2 principles: same-target pairing, reference diversity and non-leakage, precise TG/SG labels, and evidence-grounded QA design. They inspect temporal-event completeness, boundary-frame box alignment, and the uniqueness and evidential support of QA answers. For AV cases, they also verify native-audio dependence and audio-visual alignment. They correct clear annotation errors, recheck the revised cases, and submit the confirmed cases to the lead expert. The expert resolves remaining inconsistencies, makes necessary corrections, performs final acceptance, and audits the release-ready data. These steps require approximately 320 annotator-hours and 500 lead-expert-hours . Appendix D details the process. Tables D1 and D2 report video-level verification results and typical issues; Table D3 details human effort by stage and role.
blocks.zh: 第三阶段:质量核查和最后审定。 所有附加说明的案件在释放前都要经过案例一级的质量核查。 4位同龄人对照第2阶段的原则独立交叉核对说明:同目标配对,参考多样性和非漏取,精确的TG/SG标签,以及有证据依据的QA设计. 它们检查时间事件的完整性,边界框对齐,以及质量保证答案的独特性和证据支持。 对于AV案例,他们还核实本土-音频依赖和视听相通. 他们纠正了明显的注释错误,重新检查了修改后的病例,并将确诊病例报送主要专家. 专家解决了其余的不一致之处,作出必要的更正,进行最后验收,并审计已放行的数据。 这些步骤需要大约320个注释小时和500个牵头专家小时。 附 录 D详细介绍了过程. 表D1和D2报告视频层面的核查结果和典型问题; 表D3按阶段和作用详细列出了人类的努力。

blocks.en: 3.3 Benchmark Statistics
blocks.zh: 3.3 基准统计

blocks.en:
Video Diversity and Temporal Scale. OmniCompass contains 820 videos across 7 domains and 52 subcategories , with 10–43 videos per subcategory and a mean of 15.8.
The videos total 80.6 hours , ranging from 30 seconds to 88.4 minutes, with a mean duration of 354.0 seconds.
Figure 4 (a,b) shows 162 short, 309 medium, and 349 long videos across 15 duration bins, including 580 VL-only videos and 240 videos shared by both tracks for matched-video evaluation.

Implementation Details. (i) Frame sampling: We uniformly sample 64 frames for proprietary models and open-source models with over 100B total parameters, and 32 for smaller models.
GPT-series models use 49 frames to accommodate the Text+Image reference within the 50-image limit.
VITA-1.5-7B follows its official 16-frame limit.
Following TimeLens ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , each frame is immediately preceded by its timestamp in seconds. (ii) Input modalities: OmniCompass-VL excludes audio, while OmniCompass-AV adds the native audio following WorldSense ( Hong et al., 2026 ) and Video-MME-v2 ( Fu et al., 2026 ) .
In Text+Image , the reference image follows these inputs and immediately precedes the task prompt.
Appendix E details the experimental setup, input serialization, and task-specific prompts and response formats.

Impact of Frame-Level Timestamps. Figure 7 shows that timestamps improve CS Avg \mathrm{CS}^{\mathrm{Avg}} in all five model-track configurations, with gains in 14 of 15 task-level comparisons.
On the VL track, Gemini-3.8-Flash, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, and Qwen3.8-27B gain 7.0%, 10.4%, and 2.3%, averaging 6.5% .
On the AV track, Gemini-3.8-Flash and Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash gain 3.6% and 6.2%, averaging 4.9% .
VL gains concentrate in TG: Gemini-3.8-Flash and Qwen3.5-397B-A17B gain 18.3% and 18.2% .
In AV, Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash gains 16.0% in SG, while TG changes by -0.2% to +0.8% across both models.
QA improves in every comparison by 0.7%–5.9%.
These results suggest that timestamps help align sampled frames with temporal positions.

blocks.en: 5  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we introduce OmniCompass, a holistic benchmark for omni-modal video grounding and understanding.
It unifies TG, SG, and QA across VL and AV tracks with paired Text and Text+Image specifications for the same video, target, task semantics, and ground truth.
The benchmark covers 820 manually annotated videos across seven domains, including a 240-video AV subset with native audio.
The paired settings and CS metric assess both prediction correctness and consistency under changes in target specification.
Leading proprietary models outperform open-source models, especially in audio-visual understanding, while precise grounding, fine-grained perception, and audio-visual event binding remain challenging.
Reference images yield task-dependent effects, while timestamps improve model performance in both tracks.
These findings motivate stronger multimodal alignment and audio-aware grounding to connect target specifications with the relevant events and evidence.
OmniCompass supports joint evaluation of QA, precise grounding, and cross-reference consistency across tasks and modalities, providing a basis for diagnosing model limitations and measuring progress toward reliable omni-modal video understanding.

配对设置和CS度量评估在目标规格变化下预测正确性和一致性.

blocks.en: B.1 Impact of Frame Scaling
blocks.zh: B.1 框架放大的影响

blocks.en: Increasing the frame budget improves performance in most settings, but the effect depends on the track and task. On OmniCompass-VL, all three tasks improve significantly for both models from 8 to 128 frames. TG CS increases by 22.2% and 19.6% for Gemini-3.8-Flash and Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, respectively; SG increases by 22.8% and 16.9%, while QA increases by 20.0% and 18.6%. The gains are smaller and more task-dependent on OmniCompass-AV. SG improves by 18.3% for Gemini-3.8-Flash and 22.3% for Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash, while QA improves by 9.9% and 13.4% from 8 to 128 frames. In contrast, TG remains nearly unchanged. We suppose that audio already provides useful temporal cues for AV TG (see Figure 7 ), leaving denser visual sampling with limited additional temporal evidence, whereas SG and QA can benefit from finer spatial details and richer visual context. Besides, more frames also increase visual input and inference cost, so the preferred budget depends on the task and track rather than always favoring the largest setting.

TG CS在双子座-3.8-Flash和Quen3.5-397B-A17B中分别增长了22.2%和19.6%;SG增长了22.8%和16.9%,而QA增长了20.0%和18.6%. 收益较小,更依赖于OmniCompass-AV。 SG的双子座-3.8-Flash改进了18.3%,Quen3.8-Omni-Flash改进了22.3%,而QA则改进了9.9%和13.4%,从8到128帧. 相反,TG几乎没有变化。 我们认为,音频已经为AV TG提供了有用的时间提示(见图7),使更密集的视觉取样具有有限的额外时间证据,而SG和QA则可以从更细的空间细节和更丰富的视觉上下文中受益. 此外,更多的帧也增加了视觉输入和推论成本,因此首选的预算取决于任务和跟踪,而不是总是倾向于最大的设定.

访问和再分配必须遵守适用的源词,包括对视频和参考图像的任何限制。

blocks.en:
We use Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025 ) to profile 8,489 domain-aligned public candidates.
The outputs describe entities, actions, attributes, and scenes, together with a video description and corresponding counts.
The archived records use identity for entity information.
Figure C2 presents the profiling template with this field displayed as entity for consistency with the paper’s terminology.
These automatic descriptions guide candidate selection; annotators construct questions, localize the required evidence, and verify answers.
blocks.zh:
我们使用Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct(Bai等,2025年)来剖析8,489个域相通的公众候选人.
产出描述实体、动作、属性和场景,以及视频描述和相应的计数。
存档记录使用身份获取实体信息.
图C2显示了与该文件术语一致的、作为实体显示的这个字段的剖析模板。
这些自动描述指导候选人的选择;注释者构建问题,将所需证据本地化并核实答案.

blocks.en: detailed_description : 3–6 sentences, time order.
blocks.zh: 详细介绍:3–6句,时间顺序.

blocks.en: entity : list categories with instance_count and short notes.
blocks.zh: 实体 : 列表类别,包含实例_计数和简短注释。

blocks.en: action : up to 12 distinct temporally localizable action variants.
blocks.zh: 行动: 最多12个在时间上可以区分的动作变体。

blocks.en: attribute : up to 12 distinct visible cues.
blocks.zh: 属性 : 最多12个明显的可见提示。

blocks.en: scene : up to 6 distinct phases, shots, or contexts.
blocks.zh: 场景:最多6个不同阶段、镜头或背景。

blocks.en: counts : entity = sum of entity.instance_count ; others = list lengths.
blocks.zh: 计数:实体=实体.intance_count;其他=列表长度.

blocks.en: Figure C2 : Structured video profiling prompt used with Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct .
blocks.zh: 图C2:与Quen3-VL-8B-Instruct一起使用的结构化视频剖析快取.

blocks.en:
Deterministic filtering removes 1,454 candidates shorter than 30 seconds, leaving 7,035 videos.
A further 89 lack at least one of the four cue types, yielding 6,946 eligible public candidates.
The filtering criteria require positive entity, action, attribute, and scene counts alongside the metadata used by the selection pipeline.
These counts describe the candidate pool before manual task construction, not validated benchmark questions.
blocks.zh:
决定性的过滤会删除短于30秒的1,454名候选人,留下了7,035个视频.
另有89人缺少至少一种4个线索类型,产生了6 946名合格的公众候选人。
过滤标准要求正实体、动作、属性和场景计数与选择管道所使用的元数据相并列。
这些计数描述的是人工任务构建之前的候选人才库,而不是经过验证的基准问题.

blocks.en: C.2 Task-Oriented Candidate Scoring
blocks.zh: C.2 以任务为方向的候选人评分

blocks.en:
Candidate ranking combines reference necessity R R , grounding suitability G G , temporal-spatial utility T T , and evidence diversity E E as S = 0.35 ​ R + 0.25 ​ G + 0.25 ​ T + 0.15 ​ E S=0.35R+0.25G+0.25T+0.15E .
These heuristic components use structured profiling statistics, not model evaluation scores.
Table C2 defines the recorded component calculations on a zero-to-ten scale.
Scores inform shortlisting together with domain, duration, source, and subcategory coverage; human curation determines the retained public set.
blocks.zh:
候选人的排名结合了参考必要性R , 证明适合性G G , 时间-空间用途T T, 和证据多样性E E 作为S = 0.35 R + 0.25 G + 0.25 T + 0.15 E = 0.35R+ 6.25G+ 6.25T+0.15E.
这些高压成分使用结构化剖面统计,而不是模型评价分数.
表C2定义了以0至10个比例尺记录的组件计算.
分数与域、期限、来源和亚类的涵盖范围一起为入围名单提供信息;人文管理决定了保留的公共集。

blocks.en: Table C2 : Mapping from structured video profiling outputs to task-oriented scoring signals. We summarize how the structured video profiling outputs produced by Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct are converted into intermediate statistics and then used to compute the four score components.
blocks.zh: 表C2:从结构化视频剖析输出到面向任务的评分信号的映射. 我们总结一下如何将Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct公司制作的结构化视频剖析输出转换成中间统计,然后用来计算四个分数部分.

blocks.en: C.3 Question-Answering Taxonomy
blocks.zh: C.3 问答分类

blocks.en: Figure C3 : QA taxonomy in our OmniCompass-VL and OmniCompass-AV.
blocks.zh: 图C3:我们的OmniCompass-VL和OmniCompass-AV中的QA分类学。

blocks.en:
QA types are grouped by the dominant operation needed to answer each question.
Perception covers direct recognition and judgments from the available evidence, while reasoning covers temporal, causal, or comparative relations.
Both tracks use five answer options, but their type sets differ because AV questions are designed to draw on speech, sound, or joint audio-visual evidence.
The shared format standardizes scoring without equating difficulty across tracks.
blocks.zh:
质量保证类型按回答每个问题所需的主导操作分类。
观念包括从现有证据中直接承认和判断,而推理包括时间、因果关系或比较关系。
两个音轨都使用五个答案选项,但其类型集因AV问题被设计为取材于语音,声音,或联合视听证据而不同.
共享格式使评分标准化,而不对等各道难度。

blocks.en:
OmniCompass-VL contains eight QA types, listed in Table C3 and shown in Figure C3 .
Fact Recognition, Action Recognition, Attribute Perception, Visual Counting, and Spatial Perception form the perception group.
Temporal Reasoning, Causal Reasoning, and Comparative Judgment form the reasoning group.
Labels follow the answering operation, not individual words in the question.
blocks.zh:
OmniCompass-VL包含8个QA类型,列于表C3中并如图C3所示.
事实识别、行动识别、属性感知、视觉计数和空间感知构成感知群体。
时间理性、原因理性和比较判断构成推理组。
标签跟随回答操作,而不是问题中的单个单词.

blocks.en: Table C3 : QA taxonomy and examples in OmniCompass-VL. We group the eight QA types into Perception and Reasoning. Examples show only the question text from the Text target-specification setting; answer options are omitted.
blocks.zh: 表C3: QA分类学和OmniCompass-VL中的例子. 我们把八种QA分为感知和理性. 示例只显示文本目标设置中的问题文本;省略答案选项.

blocks.en:
OmniCompass-AV contains five QA types, listed in Table C4 and shown in Figure C3 .
Speech Understanding, Event Understanding, and Emotion Recognition form the perception group; Temporal Reasoning and Causal Reasoning form the reasoning group.
Event Understanding links audible cues to visible participants, actions, states, or context.
These labels describe intended evidence requirements, rather than a measured guarantee that every item fails when audio is removed.
blocks.zh:
OmniCompass-AV包含5个质量保证类型,列表于表C4并如图C3所示.
语音理解、事件理解和情感识别构成感知组; 时间理性和因果关系构成推理组。
事件理解将可见的提示与可见的参与者、行动、状态或上下文联系起来。
这些标签描述的是预期的证据要求,而不是一个衡量的保证,即每件物品在去除音频时都会失败.

blocks.en: Table C4 : QA taxonomy and examples in OmniCompass-AV. We group the five QA types into Perception and Reasoning. Examples show only the question text from the Text target-specification setting; answer options are omitted.
blocks.zh: 表C4: QA分类学和OmniCompass-AV中的例子. 我们把五个QA类型分成了感知和理性. 示例只显示文本目标设置中的问题文本;省略答案选项.

blocks.en: C.4 Reference Design and Provenance
blocks.zh: C.4 参考设计和证明

blocks.en:
Reference images identify a target through entity, action, attribute, or scene information, as defined in Table C5 .
The unit of analysis is a task-specific reference, not a unique image file or video.
Each of the 820 VL videos contributes one reference for TG, SG, and QA, yielding 2,460 task instances.
Tasks can select different targets; their cue types and sources are counted separately.
blocks.zh:
参考图像通过表C5所定义的实体,动作,属性,或场景信息来识别一个目标.
分析的单位是一个任务特定的参考,而不是独一无二的图像文件或视频.
820个VL视频中每个视频都为TG,SG和QA提供了一款参考,生成了2,460个任务实例.
任务可以选择不同的目标;其提示类型和来源被分别计算.

blocks.en: Table C5 : Functional taxonomy of reference information in OmniCompass-VL. Each type states what the reference image contributes to target identification and gives representative examples.
blocks.zh: 表C5:OmniCompass-VL中参考信息的功能分类。 每种类型都说明参考图像对目标识别的贡献,并提供具有代表性的例子。

blocks.en:
Figure C4 : Reference composition across 2,460 VL task instances. Panel (a) shows overall cue-type frequencies, (b) shows their proportions by domain, and (c) compares video-internal and Internet sources.
Counts are reported per task instance, so an image reused across tasks is counted more than once.
blocks.zh:
图C4:2 460个VL任务实例的参考构成。 专门小组(a) 显示总的Cue-类型频率,(b) 按领域显示其比例,(c) 比较视频-内部和因特网来源。
每个任务实例都报告计数,因此一个跨任务再利用的图像不止一次被计数.

blocks.en:
Entity cues account for 1,960 of the 2,460 references, or 79.7%.
The remaining references comprise 171 action cues, 200 attribute cues, and 129 scene cues.
The examples include recognizable actions in Sports and appearance-based vehicle distinctions in Traffic.
Figure C4 reports domain-wise frequencies; the cue types are not equally represented in this set.
blocks.zh:
实体提示占2,460个参考文献中的1,960个,占79.7%.
其余参考文献包括171个动作提示、200个属性提示和129个场景提示。
这些例子包括体育领域的可识别行动和交通方面的外观车辆区分。
图 C4 报告域向频率; 提示类型在本集中并不相同 。

blocks.en:
The reference set contains 1,933 video-internal images and 527 Internet images.
Video-internal crops preserve the identity of targets specific to a recording, while external exemplars can specify recognizable people, objects, or actions.
Source selection follows the identification needs of each annotation rather than a fixed per-domain quota.
This variation is part of the benchmark’s reference conditions and is not an independently controlled source-modality experiment.
blocks.zh:
参考集包含1,933个视频-内部图像和527个互联网图像.
视频-内部收成保存了录音所特有目标的身份,而外部实例可以指定可识别的人,物品,或动作.
来源选择遵循每个注释的识别需要,而不是每个领域固定的配额。
这种变化是基准参考条件的一部分,不是独立控制的源模式试验。

blocks.en:
For video-internal references, annotation guidelines favor a separate view outside the target interval or QA clue interval whenever one is available.
Reviewers also inspect whether the image reveals the answer event, since temporal separation alone does not rule out semantic leakage.
Crops retain target-identifying content while limiting irrelevant context and direct answer evidence.
These checks aim to separate target specification from the evidence needed to solve the task.
blocks.zh:
对于视频内部引用,注释准则倾向于在目标间隔或QA线索间隔之外单独查看,只要有线索间隔。
审查者还检查图像是否揭示出答案事件,因为时间分离本身并不排除语义泄漏.
作物保留目标识别内容,同时限制无关上下文和直接回答证据。
这些检查旨在将目标规格与完成任务所需的证据分开。

blocks.en: Appendix D Annotation Quality and Verification
blocks.zh: 附录D 说明质量和核查

blocks.en: D.1 Review Criteria and Repair Records
blocks.zh: D.1 审查标准和维修记录

blocks.en:
Quality control combines semantic review with structural validation.
Reviewers check paired-setting target identity, temporal-event completeness, endpoint box alignment, QA answer uniqueness, and evidence sufficiency.
AV review additionally examines speech or sound dependence and audio-visual correspondence.
Returned corrections undergo task-level re-verification and lead-expert acceptance.
Tables D1 and D2 summarize verification stages and representative issues.
blocks.zh:
质量控制结合语义审查与结构验证.
审查者检查配对设定目标身份,时间事件完整性,端点框对齐,QA回答独有性,证据充足.
AV审查还审查了语音或声音依赖和视听通信。
返回的惩戒经过任务一级的再核查和牵头专家的接受。
表D1和D2概述了核查阶段和代表性问题。

blocks.en: D.2 Human Effort
blocks.zh: D.2 人类努力

blocks.en:
The construction and verification records yield a retrospective estimate of 1,784 human-hours, or 223 eight-hour person-days.
This comprises 1,280 annotator-hours and 504 lead-expert-hours, as detailed in Table D3 .
The estimate covers training, task construction, cross-verification, correction, adjudication, and final auditing.
It is reconstructed from project records rather than continuous time logs and excludes automated processing, model inference, and waiting periods.
blocks.zh:
建筑和核查记录可追溯估计1 784人/小时,即223人/日。
如表D3所详述的,这包括1,280个注释小时和504个牵头专家小时。
估计数包括培训、任务建造、交叉核查、纠正、裁定和最后审计。
它从项目记录中重建,而不是连续的时间记录,不包括自动化处理、模型推论和等待期。

blocks.en: Table D1 : Multi-stage quality verification for OmniCompass-VL. All counts use the final 820-video release set. A video passes only when its paired Text and Text+Image specifications and its TG, SG, and QA annotations satisfy the verification criteria. Representative findings are non-exclusive.
blocks.zh: 表D1: OmniCompass-VL的多阶段质量核查。 所有计数都使用最后的820视频发布集. 视频只有在配对的"文本"和"文本+图像"规格及其"TG","SG"和"QA说明"符合核查标准时,才能通过. 具有代表性的调查结果不是排他性的。

blocks.en: Table D2 : Multi-stage quality verification for OmniCompass-AV. All counts use the 240-video AV subset of the final release. In addition to the shared VL criteria, annotators check native-audio dependence and audio-visual alignment, and the lead expert includes these criteria in final acceptance and audit. Representative findings are non-exclusive.
blocks.zh: 表D2:OmniCompass-AV的多阶段质量核查。 所有计数使用最终发行的240-video AV子集. 除了共同的VL标准外,注释者还检查本土-音频依赖性和视听相通性,首席专家在最终验收和审计中纳入了这些标准. 具有代表性的调查结果不是排他性的。

blocks.en: Table D3 : Estimated human effort for OmniCompass construction and quality assurance. Hours are reconstructed from dated project records using an eight-hour workday. Automated processing, inference, and waiting time are excluded.
blocks.zh: 表D3:OmniCompaass建筑和质量保证方面的人类努力估计数。 使用8小时的工作日从过时的项目记录中重建小时。 自动处理、推论和等待时间不包括在内。

blocks.en: Appendix E Evaluation Protocols and Prompts
blocks.zh: 附录E 评价协议和提示

blocks.en: E.1 Inputs and Paired Settings
blocks.zh: E.1 输入和投放设置

blocks.en:
Frames are sampled uniformly across full videos.
The standard budget is 64 for proprietary models and open-source models above 100B total parameters, and 32 otherwise.
GPT-series runs use 49 frames to reserve a reference slot within the evaluated 50-image input limit; VITA-1.5-7B uses 16.
Budgets remain fixed within a model across tasks and reference settings.
Cross-model results therefore reflect the stated input budgets, not a strictly equal-compute comparison.
blocks.zh:
整个视频都统一取样。
标准预算为专有模式和开源模式64个,总参数高于100B,另32个.
GPT系列运行使用49帧来保留被评价的50-图像输入限制内的参考槽;VITA-1.5-7B使用16.
预算仍固定在跨任务和参考环境的模式内。
因此,跨模式成果反映了所说明的投入预算,而不是严格的等量计算比较。

Each timestamp is literal text in seconds from the start of the video, placed immediately before its corresponding frame, following the design of TimeLens ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
The frame numbers index sampled frames from zero: <frame 0> is the first, and <frame 63> is the last in these 64-frame examples.
Angle-bracketed items denote media content, not literal text tokens. <audio> is the video’s audio track, and <ref image> is the task-specific reference image.

The timestamps shown are specific to these clips, not fixed for other videos or frame budgets.
Within each pair, the video evidence, task semantics, and ground truth are shared; only the target specification changes.
